notes.title: Version 1.1.3 Release
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where the relic discard dialog would appear if a new relic dropped after defeating an enemy with a relic's activation when you possessed 3 relics.
- Fixed an issue that caused unintended behavior when one of several bosses was defeated by the "Damage on Full Block" effect while possessing the amulet "Triumphant Return".
- Fixed an issue that caused unintended behavior when resuming a suspended session in Zangetsudo after performing a specific action.

notes.title: Version 1.1.2 Release
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where resuming during a battle immediately after leaving “Zangetsudo” could cause the game to become unplayable.
- Fixed various bugs.

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 Release
notes.notes:
Update
- Added a feature that allows you to re-roll investigation rewards.
- Improved the display of Creation Cards selected at the start of an investigation and creation.
Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where Jinma Cards were sometimes not registered in the Jinmapedia or Jinma Archive after retiring or clearing an investigation.
- Fixed an issue where Jinma cards obtained through map events were not properly added to the Jinma Archive.
- Fixed an issue that allowed players to possess more than four Relics.

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Release
notes.notes:
Update
- The new "Badge" feature has been added.
- Added new events that can occur during an investigation.
- You can now select which Relic to discard when you reach your possession limit.
- Implemented features related to Mangetsu and Hangetsu, which are scheduled for release on 6/30.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where the notification to claim the pass's Daily Bonus would not disappear after the Premium Pass had expired.
- Fixed an issue where ending the turn immediately after using a Relic would delay its activation until the start of the next turn.

notes.title: Version 1.0.6 Release
notes.notes:
Update
- The new "Jinmapedia" feature has been added.
- You can now change image for a Creation Jinma Cards by consuming Seals.
- When you open the Discard list during battle, you can now switch to the Lock Up Cards list to check which cards have been Lock Up.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where status icons could sometimes display incorrectly when resuming an interrupted battle.

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 Release
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where, on the final floor of each investigation area, Jinma Cards could not be obtained as battle rewards.
- Fixed an issue where, when account linking is set up and you play on multiple devices during a single investigation, save data from an interrupted investigation could sometimes become invalid.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Release
notes.notes:
Update
- Added three new modes to the endgame content "THE HASHIRA".
- Added the option to "Fast battle mode" in the settings.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where, upon resuming from interruption with the [Wall] status active, previously applied debuffs were removed and Wall charges were consumed incorrectly. Also fixed a related issue where resuming under this condition could cause the game to become unprogressable.
- Fixed an issue where the [Right Path] status was not correctly retained when resuming an exploration or moving to the next floor.
- Fixed an issue where using the Shingetsu Tsukuyomi Creation Jinma Card effect to "Return all cost 0 Lock Up cards to the deck" would leave unusable gaps in the hand.
- Fixed an issue where, after defeating a boss and receiving an Amulet reward, resuming the game could result in a progression block.
- Fixed an issue where a network timeout during the completion of Creation could cause the game to become unprogressable.
- Fixed an issue where the remaining Odo display could differ from the actual count.
- Fixed an issue where the changed screen size settings were not saved after restarting the game.

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Release
notes.notes:
Update
- The menu item ""Discord"" has been changed to ""SNS"". Links to ""X"", ""Discord"", and the ""Strategy Guide"" have been added under this ""SNS"" category.You can obtain Seals by navigating to ""X"" from within the game and following the official account.
- After the update, tutorial dialogs will now be displayed the first time a reward Jinma Card is selected from a normal battle, and also the first time the Resting room is visited.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where the illustration for the ""Prime Created Card"" was not displaying as intended.
- Fixed an issue where the count for Prime Created Cards displayed in the ""PRIME JINMA ARCHIVE"" would incorrectly show as ""0/1"" even after a card had been acquired through Investigation.

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Release
notes.notes:
Update
- You can now ""Save and Return to Title"" from the in-battle menu.
- Added ""Fast Text Display"" to the Options menu.
- In Blessings, you can now open term details from the effect descriptions of unlockable Relics and Amulets.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue on THE HASHIRA 20F and 40F where the floor bonus ""Moon Fragments +50%"" was not applied.
- Fixed an issue where the status ""Repetition"" sometimes failed to interact with the card effect ""Odo+.""
- Fixed an issue where the card effect ""Right Seeker"" might not apply correctly when starting a battle or resuming a suspended battle.
- Fixed an issue where ""Free Unleash"" and ""Watch Ad to Unleash"" in Blessings could display incorrectly the first time they appeared after the daily reset.
- Fixed an issue where a gift icon could remain on NEWS even after the present had been claimed.
- Fixed an issue that could prevent detail pop-ups from being closed during battle.
- Fixed an issue that could hide the Relics list during battle.
- Fixed an issue in Story Log where unread scenarios might appear.
- Added scenarios that were missing from Story Log.
- When replaying Story Log, the animation that adds cards to the deck has been omitted to prevent unintended visuals.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Release
notes.notes:
Updates
• Made the activation of the Jinma Mark on Created Cards easier to see. 
• Clarified the effect display for the Premium Pass .

Bug Fixes 
• Fixed an issue where costs altered by ""Confusion"" status did not revert after the status cleared. 
• Fixed an issue that caused the cost of the Jinma Card “Buer” to display incorrect values. 
• Fixed an issue where Relics effects failed to apply to other Relics depending on acquisition order. 
• Fixed incorrect card cost or block values after resuming a suspended battle. 
• Fixed “Intimidation” Relic not triggering against the Jinma “Shichinin Misaki”. 
• Fixed taking damage when defeating Jinma “Decarabia” via Full Block–Reflect damage. 
• Fixed status ""Bleed"" increasing before damage was taken when struck by ""Ripper"" while Bleeding. 
• Fixed Jinma “Tonkaraton” retrieving a card and inadvertently triggering its Link effect. 
• Fixed Tsukuyomi Blessings sometimes not appearing on the results screen.
• Corrected lines that remained in Japanese when another language was selected.
